risk_if_not_implemented: Without Safe Operations, Operational Technology (OT) and embedded systems may fail unsafely or be manipulated, endangering personnel, physical assets and process availability. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to R-SA-1, R-AI-3, R-AI-5, R-OT-1, R-SF-1, R-SF-2, and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12), Artificial Intelligence & Autonomous Technologies (AAT) System Failure or Unintended Behavior (MT-13), Operational Technology (OT) / Industrial Control System (ICS) Attack (MT-30).

compensating_control_1.name: Safety Assessment
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to evaluate the safety aspects of embedded technologies via a fault tree analysis, or similar method, to determine possible consequences of misuse, misconfiguration and/or failure.
compensating_control_1.justification: Safety Assessment (EMB-23) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Safe Operations (EMB-23) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Risk Assessment
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct recurring assessments of risk that includes the likelihood and magnitude of harm, from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification or destruction of the organization's Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD).
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk Assessment (RSK-13) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Safe Operations (EMB-23) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
